reviews.text:
My mini Bernedoodle Stevie has the pleasure of joining Cees&co every Tuesday and Wednesday.

She is wagging her tail in the morning, ready to be picked up. She thinks it is fantastic and feels incredibly satisfied afterwards. And the videos I receive every time during the walk make me at least just as happy!
Friendly, flexible and reliable service :-). Our dog always comes home happy!

Yesterday morning around 09:45, I was traveling from Almere to Amsterdam. On the on-ramp to the highway, I wanted to turn right twice to enter the highway, but on one occasion the road ended for merging.

Both times, I ended up in a dangerous traffic situation with my wife and young children in the car due to the same driver, who accelerated hard so that I could not merge.

Once on the highway, the same person was tailgating me. I later noticed that this is a company van used to transport dogs for a dog walking service. I would not do business with this company.

Super satisfied with Cees & Company!! Moji now goes along three times a week and enjoys himself immensely every time. They turn it into really fun outings and, for example, regularly take the dogs to the beach.

What I also really appreciate is that they always send videos. That way, you can see how much fun the dogs are having together and how Moji is happily running and playing. He is always picked up enthusiastically and comes home satisfied afterwards.

Truly a wonderful and reliable dog walking service. I let Moji go with them with peace of mind. Absolutely 5 stars! ❤️

My Dachshund has been joining Cees and Co. for quite some time with immense pleasure. Upon their return, he is always satisfied, and the usual videos of the trip are a joy to watch. In every way, this company and the lovely people are exceptionally dedicated and professional at the same time.
Great dog walking service, reliable and attentive!
A very bad driver, I really wouldn't trust my dogs to him.

Tommy, a Grand Basset Griffon, is always super satisfied when he comes home.

In the morning, he lies waiting anxiously for his big friends from Cees&co.
Best dog walking service in the Netherlands!
